control_profile: continuous adverse-price discount, downward volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, close-confirmed loss stop and one-way turnover cap
falsifier: Expected whole-book carry is not positive, adverse price movement consumes the carry, or the result is nonpositive under doubled or tripled costs and nearby funding windows.
formation_horizon: robust seven-day and twenty-eight-day settled-funding estimates with a nine-bar residual price state
hypothesis: The cross-sectional spread between persistently high and low settled funding rates compensates a broad short-high-rate and long-low-rate portfolio after continuously discounting adverse price paths.
rebalance_horizon: one daily cohort with three equally weighted overlapping cohorts
